job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities




5 to 8 years of experience
Production GenAI experience with Amazon Bedrock, Langchain /Langraph, SageMaker and/or equivalent platforms; hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector stores, prompt engineering and AI agents/AgentCore.
Strong hands-on AWS experience, particularly serverless and cloud-native services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Step Functions, EventBridge and S3.
Strong Python development skills, with experience building production-grade AI/ML applications and APIs.
Strong understanding of RAG architectures, agentic workflows, vector databases, model integration, and LLM application optimization.
IaC and DevOps fluency using CDK/Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, containerization and production deployment practices.
AWS Certification(s) such as Developer, Solutions Architect, Machine Learning or Generative AI Engineer would be strongly preferred.
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG and LangGraph experience, AWS deployment, FastAPI backend, but lacks some serverless and IaC skills.
